headline: Colombia Prepares Quarterly GDP Report Amid National Minimum Wage Debates
summary: Colombia's DANE statistic agency will release quarterly economic growth data following first-half GDP growth of 2.9%, as union leaders and business associations debate minimum wage adjustments.
why: Colombia is South America's fourth-largest economy, where official GDP data and minimum wage mandates impact inflation dynamics and business costs.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Quarterly economic output metrics determine macro growth trajectories and fiscal policies.
